text: she committed her whoredoms with them: Heb. bestowed her whoredoms upon them | chose men of Assyria: Heb. the choice of the children of Asshur
she was more corrupt in her inordinate love then she: Heb. she corrupted her inordinate love more then etc. | more then her sister in her whoredoms: Heb. more then the whoredoms of her sister
as soon as she saw: Heb. at the sight of her eyes
Babylonians: Heb. children of Babel | alienated from them: Heb. tossed or disjointed
fair jewels: Heb. instruments of thy decking
common sort: Heb. of the multitude of men | Sabeans: Or, drunkards
whoredoms with her: Heb. Her whoredoms
to be removed and spoiled: Heb. for a removing and spoil
dispatch them: Or, single them out
